text:
Sam_Sales: Quick handoff 3 Solstice Analytics (Enterprise, 50 seats). Sale done; they require private deployment in their AWS acct, Azure AD SAML, and daily embedding sync to their ES cluster. Passing to CS + eng/support. Short context below.

Renee_CS: Thanks Sam. What's the contractual start and target pilot date? Any non-negotiable security asks?

Sam_Sales: Contract start 2025-12-01. Pilot target 2025-12-15, full roll 2026-02-28. Must-haves:
- Private VPC (customer-managed AWS account)
- Azure AD SAML + SCIM for provisioning later
- Data residency: logs may not leave their VPC; they want a log-forwarder to their Splunk instance
- P95 chat latency <=250ms, embedding freshness <=12h for search indexing

Devon_CSE: Do we have their Azure metadata and the Splunk endpoint? Also ask if they want our managed metric export or to pull metrics.

Sam_Sales: Primary Azure admin is marta@solstice.io. She expects to share metadata next week. Splunk forwarder details pending; they prefer us to push logs to a presigned S3 which their ops will ingest.

Ivy_Eng: Network note: VPC peering + egress approval typically 10-14 business days. We'll need CIDR, expected outbound IPs, and estimated QPS. Who owns infra tickets?

Hassan_Support: I'll take support ownership for escalation path and alerting. Please create infra ticket and a runbook ticket.

Renee_CS: I'll own onboarding (kickoff doc + success metrics) and coordinate enablement. Action owners listed below.

Sam_Sales: Traffic numbers from customer: steady-state 60 QPS chat, peak 150 QPS; embeddings ~2M vectors daily, batch window 02:00-05:00 UTC.

Devon_CSE: SAML/SCIM tasks: initial SAML connect, then SCIM group mapping after pilot. I'll reach out to Marta for metadata and provisioning scope.

Ivy_Eng: I'll open INFRA-9001 for private deploy and peering and list required egress ranges and routing policy. Need confirmation if they require static egress IPs (they *might* for firewall rules).

Sam_Sales: They said firewall will only accept explicit IPs. Ask Marta for network contact (CC'd?) and push for metadata earlier.

deploybot: Created ticket INFRA-9001 (assignee: unassigned)

Hassan_Support: @deploybot also create SUPPORT-4555 for escalation/runbook please.

deploybot: Created ticket SUPPORT-4555 (assignee: Hassan_Support)

Renee_CS: Kickoff doc checklist I'm adding: 
- Success metrics: P95 <250ms chat, embedding freshness <12h, pilot availability 99.6%
- Data flows: logs -> customer S3 (encrypted), no retention outside VPC, metrics exported to their Prometheus pushgateway
- Training: CS admin training + SRE networking walkthough (aim: week of 12/08)
- Renewal criteria: pilot usage thresholds + exec check-in post 30 days (owner: Renee_CS)

Devon_CSE: Quick SAML hint to share with Marta (ask for full XML, but this minimal snippet helps):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example/saml">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://redwood-inference.example/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Ivy_Eng: For routing policy they want model pinning to redwood-5b-std; fallback path to redwood-3b-fp16 during capacity constraints. I'll include canary rollout and static egress IP options in INFRA-9001.

Sam_Sales: Also a note on compliance: they require customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest. Please confirm compatibility with our private deploy package.

Ivy_Eng: We support CMK integration in private deployments. I'll add KMS tasks to INFRA-9001 and list required IAM roles.

Renee_CS: Action owners + deadlines (tentative):
- Renee_CS: Kickoff doc + success metrics (due 2025-11-20)
- Ivy_Eng: Create INFRA-9001 with routing/canary/KMS checklist (create by 2025-11-05)
- Devon_CSE: Initiate SAML contact and request metadata + SCIM scope (contact by 2025-11-03)
- Hassan_Support: Draft escalation runbook + initial alerts (draft by 2025-11-25)
- Sam_Sales: Send network contact + push for metadata (ongoing)

Hassan_Support: I'll map alert thresholds and include playbooks for auth failures, high latency, and embedding job failures.

Devon_CSE: Reaching out to marta@solstice.io now. Will post metadata and any SSO test results here.

Sam_Sales: Please ACK owners so I can communicate internal team to the customer tomorrow.

Renee_CS: ACK 3 I'll finalize kickoff doc and share link here by 2025-11-20.

Hassan_Support: ACK 3 will take SUPPORT-4555 and link to INFRA-9001 once INFRA ticket exists.

Ivy_Eng: ACK 3 creating INFRA-9001 today and will assign.

Devon_CSE: ACK 3 pinged Marta.

Sam_Sales: Great work team. Keeping thread open 3 paste any metadata/files here so we have a single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
